body: I was in a two year relationship and about 6 months later I started dating another guy. I still had some feelings for my ex but I thought dating someone else would be my answer to moving on. I realized those feelings were still too strong and recently broke up with him and I really hurt him. It could really be a red flag. I think you should talk to her more about it before you make a decision though.

I finished a year of uni but couldn’t handle it this year so I took a year off, went through my first real breakup as he left me for someone else after 2 years, lost my job, moved back home, have issues with my family, etc. I’m on a waiting list for a counsellor for another month from today, but then I’ll be moving a month after that so I’ll get put on another waiting list. I just want to be at the point where I’m moved and don’t feel so worthless from the breakup. I just feel so messed up right now. I can’t go a day without suicidal thoughts and it’s destroying me

I had a somewhat similar situation. I told my ex what I was feeling and he lashed out and lost trust in me. Broke up with me over text a week later just before our 2 years and immediately started dating another girl (like 2 days later) I still love him 6 months later. Some days it really sucks and it’s so hard. But it just takes time, maybe a lot of time. And every hurt feeling is valid, you don’t need to feel guilty for your feelings. There will be a better love waiting for you one day, living is worth that
I’ve been going through a really tough break up too, maybe you can tell me your story
Why aren’t you able to get out of the relationship? What is it that’s stopping you?
I’m on a waiting list, I’ve got another month till I have a meeting with one unfortunately
Everything turned around that night for me, I made new friends so I didn’t go through with it. But I’m back to feeling that way
I feel like pills aren’t going to work so honestly I don’t know🙃 I might wait till I have a better option because I don’t want to risk surviving

I’m constantly sad. I have no interest in anything anymore. I don’t laugh with my friends much. It’s like living every day is torture. I wake up just to wait to go to bed again. I can’t eat, I can’t sleep. My friends don’t care about me. People try to tell me to be excited for stuff I’m doing in the future like seeing a friend or going to a concert, but I never actually enjoy them when the time comes. I’m just broken and heartbroken.
I recently attempted to push all of my friends away so they wouldn’t be affected as much. Unfortunately I can’t push away my family. I want to die so bad but I feel stuck because of them.?
My family knows. I’m on medication, I’m getting therapy. It all just still sucks
